2021 Q1.gq: We are increasing our outlook for both the U.S.

2022 Q3.bq: The high end of the range is applied to the combined CDW 2021 revenues of $22.8 billion, calculated as though Sirius was acquired on January 1, 2021, instead of its actual acquisition date of December 1.

2022 Q4.bq: In aggregate, solution categories delivered results above our expectations.

2023 Q1.bq: Net sales results came in below expectations relative to our outlook.

2023 Q2.bq: Second quarter net sales were up 10.2% versus the first quarter on a reported and average daily sales basis, ahead of our outlook which had anticipated a mid-single digit seasonal increase.

2024 Q1.bq: Market conditions remained challenging, and first quarter results came in below our expectations.

2025 Q4.bq: The team delivered a strong finish to a complex year, and fourth quarter results exceeded our expectations.

2026 Q3.gq: Factoring in these variables, we now expect gross profit to grow at a mid to high single-digit rate for the full year 2026, up from our prior expectation of mid-single digits.
